description: Source code implementing the ValueSplittingHeaderList class for parsing and iterating over HTTP/2 header list values, specifically handling cookie headers and splitting header values.

classes.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList

methods.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the header list.
